games.title: Caves of Qud
games.dev: Freehold Games (Jason Grinblat and Brian Bucklew)
games.note: A science-fantasy roguelike that stayed in early access from 2015 until its full release in December 2024.

links.took: Classic dungeon crawling the founders loved, though they felt it lacked a human element.
links.added: Heroes with fragile minds who suffer stress, afflictions and quirks.

src.t: Wikipedia: Darkest Dungeon, citing Game Design Deep Dive, Gamasutra, 2015

links.extra: Chris Bourassa and Tyler Sigman named The Bard's Tale, Eye of the Beholder and Ultima Underworld as favorites.

links.took: Party-based dungeon crawling, a founders' favorite that they felt lacked a human element.
links.added: Heroes who can break down under stress and act on their own.

src.t: Wikipedia: Darkest Dungeon, citing Game Design Deep Dive, Gamasutra, 2015

links.took: The DS Castlevania games' castle exploration and RPG-style upgrades, a main inspiration per Teddy Lee.
links.added: A castle that rearranges for every heir, and upgrades bought with inherited gold.

src.t: Teddy Lee interview, Old School Gamer Magazine

links.extra: Teddy Lee named the DS Castlevania titles in general; Dawn of Sorrow was the first of them.

links.took: Skill-based action, cited alongside Dark Souls as an influence.
links.added: Skill expression inside turn-based battles through dodges, parries and counters.

links.took: Classic turn-based JRPG storytelling, from Hironobu Sakaguchi's studio Mistwalker.
links.added: Timed dodges and parries that make enemy turns active.

links.took: Co-op horror with proximity voice chat, which reviewers said it resembles.
links.added: Recording the scares for views on an in-game video site.

src.t: Wikipedia: Content Warning, citing mxdwn Games

links.took: First-person exploration of an alien world.
links.added: Building sprawling automated factories across that world.
links.extra: Eurogamer said it looked like a cross between Factorio and No Man's Sky.

links.took: Side-on digging through hazardous caves for treasure.
links.added: Building, crafting and boss fights in a persistent world.

src.t: Wikipedia: Terraria, citing Christian Donlan in Eurogamer

links.extra: Eurogamer's Christian Donlan saw it as mixing Minecraft and Spelunky.

links.took: Deep simulation of a world you dig into, cited by Terraria's developers as an influence.
links.added: Fast 2D action with bosses, loot and building.

links.took: Deep simulation and generated history, cited by Caves of Qud's developers as an influence.
links.added: A science-fantasy roguelike with mutations, factions and rich writing.

links.took: Rogue popularized turn-based dungeon crawling with permanent death.
links.added: A post-apocalyptic science-fantasy world with mutations and factions.

links.took: Deep, systemic simulation, cited by Project Zomboid's developers as an influence.
links.added: Zombie survival in a detailed, persistent Kentucky county.

links.took: Colony-style simulation, cited by Prison Architect's developers as an influence.
links.added: Designing and running a prison whose inmates riot and try to escape.

links.took: One of the childhood games Billy Basso named for similar ideas, with Metroid and Zelda.
links.added: A non-violent puzzle world full of hidden secrets.

links.took: The look of old-school isometric RPGs, one of four games the team cited for its visuals.
links.added: That visual style applied to a survivors-style horde game.

links.took: A reaction: Toby Fox felt Mother's mothers were symbols rather than characters.
links.added: Toriel, a mother figure written as a full character.

src.t: Wikipedia: Undertale, citing Toby Fox on Seagaia, 2013

links.took: Deck-building, which Party House's guest-list design has been compared to.
links.added: Inviting party guests instead of buying cards, in one of fifty games.
